A [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] '''player''' participated in the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] [[Colonies region Dejarik tournament]]. The player was losing in the quarterfinal round and took advantage of the player's [[Unidentified dejarik player (leading quarterfinal 1)|opponent's]] distraction, which was caused by a fight at another table, to reset the board. This ultimately led to both players becoming involved in the brawl.
